name: BankSync
description:
BankSync securely connects your bank, credit card, and brokerage accounts and makes their data available to Claude. 

Link your accounts once, then ask Claude about your finances in plain language.

With BankSync connected, Claude can:
• Read transactions, balances, account details, holdings, trades, and loans across all your connected institutions
• Search and filter your financial history ("how much did I spend on groceries last month?")
• Build queries, dashboards, and widgets to visualize spending, cash flow, net worth, and portfolio performance
• Sync data on a schedule to destinations like Google Sheets, Excel, and databases
• Categorize and enrich transactions automatically

BankSync handles the hard parts of financial data — institution coverage, secure consent management, deduplication, 
and keeping balances fresh — so you can focus on the insights. All access is read-only by default and scoped to the 
workspace you connect.

Whether you're tracking personal spending and net worth, reconciling the books for a business, or monitoring an 
investment portfolio, BankSync gives Claude a complete, up-to-date picture of your accounts ~ no manual exports 
required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BankSync to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BankSync to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.banksync.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BankSync MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BankSync lists 94 MCP tools, including attach_widget, cancel_job, check_template_preconditions, connect_bank, create_bank_link, create_dashboard, create_enrichment, create_feed, create_folder, create_multi_feed_query, create_portal, and create_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BankSync?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BankSync in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
BankSync requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BankSync is developed by BankSync HQ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
